facts.fact: Ethiopian News Agency reports that the Ethiopian Communications Authority, under Personal Data Protection Proclamation 1321/2016 EC, held a stakeholder consultation on its implementation, with Director General Balcha Reba saying it protects personal data under its legal mandate.
The Ministry of Justice explainer says Proclamation 1321/2016 EC gives the Ethiopian Communication Authority the main power to enforce the personal data protection law.

The US Commerce guide says transfers of personal data to countries with inadequate protection require approval from Ethiopia's data protection authority under Proclamation 1321/2024; no appointment is stated.
